items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 178:1
items.html: Even in the aspects of the breaking that have no clarification yet, before the completion of the corrections, which are the Klipot called the thirty-two stones, there are still remains of holy sparks in them, which are the secret of the eleven spices of the incense, and they are indeed very small sparks. (Item 11).
